# Environment Configuration

You can enter your API keys here:

```
GEMINI_API_KEY=AQ.Ab8RN6IXZOkotoorgnYBX-vIdDF0iT8G49wsN6IdO3hPjaDJFQ
```

Once added:
1. MARCO will load your API key automatically.
2. Alternatively, you can paste the API key directly into the running app under the **Settings (⚙️) > Gemini API Key** screen.
